name: 45-trpc-retrylink-max-attempts
title: Add maxAttempts option to retryLink
body: Adds an optional maxAttempts cap to retryLink so callers can bound retries without encoding the limit in their retry callback. Once the cap is reached the error is forwarded to the observer without consulting retry().

bugs.why: `attempts` already counts the call that just failed, so `>` lets one extra attempt through (maxAttempts: 3 makes 4 calls); the check should be `>=`.
